tel.headline: Ideas.
tel.intro: Learning worth experiencing. Businesses worth building. We turn curiosity into useful work through TEL Education and TeMark.
tel.mission: Make meaningful technology and thoughtful ideas easier to understand, experience and use.
tel.journeyIntro: TEL started with a smart-home idea. Each project, prototype and fresh start has shaped the company we are building today.

education.name: TEL Education
education.intro: Our first rocket has flown. TEL Education brings model rocket products, practical STEM and the SafeFlight learning system together. Our public launch is coming soon.
education.detail: From the model rocket kit to guided preparation through SafeFlight, we are building experiences that make classroom ideas tangible. Our first flight is complete; now we are preparing to share TEL Education with the public.
education.launchNote: First flight complete. Our public opening date will be announced here.

temark.name: TeMark by TEL
temark.intro: The creative and marketing venture of TEL. We learn how your business works, then bring strategy, campaigns, content and design together around it.
temark.approach: Every business has its own customers, location and ambitions. We take time to understand those details, shape a content plan, create the work and keep learning as the business grows.
temark.ctaIntro: Tell us about your business, your audience and what you want to achieve. Let’s discuss where TeMark can help.

services.title: Marketing strategy & campaigns
services.detail: Business understanding, marketing direction, campaign planning and coordination across the brand’s communication.

services.title: Social media management
services.detail: Content planning, calendars, publishing and a consistent presence across business accounts.

services.title: Reels & content production
services.detail: Short-form video, photography, editing and content shaped around the business.

services.title: Graphic design & campaigns
services.detail: Branded creatives, launch communication, seasonal posts and campaign visuals.

services.title: Websites & digital presence
services.detail: Clear websites and digital touchpoints that help people understand a business and make enquiries.

services.title: Performance tracking & reporting
services.detail: Following marketing and social performance, reviewing campaign activity and using the findings to shape the next plan.

milestones.title: A first idea. A habit of building.
milestones.detail: TEL’s first smart-home project begins the journey, with a simple ambition: make useful technology easier to experience.

milestones.title: Try. Learn. Fly.
milestones.detail: Early rocket prototyping brings a setback and then a breakthrough. The first attempt fails; the second flies.

milestones.title: New horizons. A fresh team.
milestones.detail: TEL reaches Delhi, receives seed support and rebuilds with a new student team.

milestones.title: From a prototype to a product.
milestones.detail: The TEL Rocket Kit becomes the flagship learning product, turning the team’s practical experience into a clearer product direction.

milestones.title: Different paths. One TEL.
milestones.detail: TEL prepares its school learning module and SafeFlight pathway, while TeMark grows its work with businesses across strategy, campaigns, social media and design. TEL Education’s public launch is still ahead.
